sn51.5:1.1: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā iddhipadesam abhinipphādesuṃ || sabbe te catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ||
sn51.5:1.2: Ye hi keci bhikkhave anāgatam addhānam samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā iddhipadesam abhinipphādessanti || sabbe te catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā || ||
sn51.5:1.3: Ye hi keci bhikkhave etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā iddhipadesam abhinipphādenti || sabbe te catunnam iddhipadānam bhavitattā bahulīkatattā ||
sn51.5:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu chandasamādhipadhānasaṅkhārasamannāgatam iddhipādam bhāveti ||
sn51.5:2.6: Ye hi keci bhikkhave atītam addhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā iddhipadesam abhipphādesuṃ
sn51.5:2.8: abhinipphādenti || sabbe te imesaṃ yeva catunnam iddhipādānam bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā ti || || (7).6. (6)
